name: Sandra Mandic
description: Named contributor in sourced geospatial conference and publication records.
story: GeoCart 2016 conference programme, New Zealand Cartographic Society lists Sandra Mandic as an author of “Routes to Dunedin secondary schools and students' perceptions of safety”; “Visualisation of active transport data”.

Cartographies of change: GeoCart 2018 proceedings, National Library of New Zealand record 40158196 lists Sandra Mandic as an author of “GIS analysis of active transport data in Dunedin”; “Spatial assessment of school neighbourhoods and adolescent travel in Dunedin”; “Spatial analysis and geovisualisation for active transport”.

Spatial aspects of a comparative study of active transport to school and motorized transport, SIRC NZ 2013 repository record, University of Otago lists Sandra Mandic as an author of “Spatial aspects of a comparative study of active transport to school and motorized transport”.
